comments.story: Acquisition of chess knowledge in AlphaZero
comments.why: Entertaining analysis of AlphaZero's uncanny pawn sacrifices against Stockfish.
comments.text: After watching some of the games AlphaZero played against Stockfish, I have to say I don't really agree that the moves make sense to a grandmaster... AlphaZero has this uncanny ability to sacrifice many pawns to restrict the movement of the opponent's pieces, something that you might see in advanced play but nowhere near the extent you see it with AlphaZero. Many more of the moves it plays are hard to make sense of compared to a classic engine such as Stockfish. See GothamChess' very entertaining analysis: [VIDEO]
